name: slipmark
description: Make AI agents prove what they checked. Bind every agent verdict to a SHA-256 of the files it read, refuse on mismatch, and diagnose AI feature drift with honest repair prompts.
author: Reply Intelligence Group Ltd

scripts.demo: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/src/cli.js dist/packs/demo-shop/pack.js --git packs/demo-shop/git-context.example.json --prompts
scripts.dashboard:sample: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/src/cli.js dashboard --from dashboard/sample-history.json --out dashboard/sample.html
scripts.demo:verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/src/cli.js verify --dir examples/attestation/attestations
